authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Lahnda/Awankari pīgh and Punjabi pī̃gh/pī̃g under prēṅkha “swing”. Punjabi University, Punjabi Vocabulary of Common Terms (2007), p. 177, Weather, explicitly uses satraṅgī pīṅgh for rainbow (https://pnarang.weebly.com/uploads/1/4/5/6/14563640/vocab_f.pdf#page=177). The simple regional survey responses retain that swing noun with a rainbow extension; the comparative-family link leaves regional borrowing open. Responses ending in unexplained m/k or containing alternatives are held.
